mechanism: Selegiline (at doses >10mg/day) inhibits monoamine oxidase and may increase serotonergic activity, while norethindrone can potentiate estrogen-dependent effects; combined use may increase thrombotic and cardiovascular risks, particularly at higher selegiline doses.
action: Monitor for signs of thromboembolism, hypertension, and serotonergic effects; consider alternative antidepressant if selegiline dose >10mg/day; counsel on contraception reliability and cardiovascular warning signs.
